# Overview

This analysis examines quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) data from two longitudinal datasets:

- **EF**: Younger cohort with TD and PS participants
- **MOTIVE**: Older cohort with TD and PS participants

**Primary Research Questions:**

1. How does susceptibility differ between TD and PS over development in the iron-rich subcortex?
2. How does susceptibility relate to cognitive performance?
3. Does QSM mediate the relationship between clinical group and cognitive performance?

# Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions}
prep_phenotypes <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      subid        = factor(subid),
      sesid        = factor(sesid),
      sex          = factor(sex,          levels = c("Male", "Female")),
      osex         = ordered(sex,         levels = c("Male", "Female")),
      study.group  = factor(study.group,  levels = c("TD", "PS")),
      ostudy.group = ordered(study.group, levels = c("TD", "PS")),
      dataset      = factor(dataset,      levels = c("EF", "MOTIVE")),
      odataset     = ordered(dataset,     levels = c("EF", "MOTIVE"))
    )
}

# Function to present results in a nicely formatted kable table
present_results <- function(results, highlight_sig = TRUE, sig_level = 0.05) {
  results %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) %>%
    kable() %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
    {
      if (highlight_sig && "p.fdr" %in% names(results))
        row_spec(., which(results$p.fdr < sig_level), bold = TRUE, color = "red")
      else .
    } %>%
    scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
}
```

```{r roi_lists}
label_roi <- function(x) { lbl <- roi_labels[x]; ifelse(is.na(lbl), x, unname(lbl)) }
label_cog <- function(x) { lbl <- cog_labels[x]; ifelse(is.na(lbl), str_remove(x, "_Efficiency"), unname(lbl)) }

# Clinical-group palette to use throughout.
group_colors <- c("TD" = "#1B9E77", "PS" = "#D55E00")

# Gather relevant model summary statistics into a tidy data frame, including partial eta-squared for smooth terms.
tidy_gam <- function(model, parametric = FALSE) {
  out.stats <- broom::tidy(model, parametric = parametric) %>%
    mutate(N = nrow(model$model)) %>%
    relocate(N, .after = term)
  if (!parametric) {
    # Partial eta-squared: effect-size measure for the smooth-term F-tests,
    # consistent with the partial η² reported for the QSM smooths in the
    # iron-cognition models.
    eta2 <- tryCatch(
      effectsize::eta_squared(model, partial = TRUE) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::select(Parameter, partial_eta2 = Eta2_partial),
      error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(eta2)) out.stats <- dplyr::left_join(out.stats, eta2, by = c("term" = "Parameter"))
  }
  out.stats
}

# Significance color + symbol helper (used in Figures 2, 3)
make_sig_label <- function(pv, pfdr) {
  if (!is.na(pfdr) && pfdr < 0.05) {
    list(col = "#d73027", sym = " \\*")
  } else if (!is.na(pv) && pv < 0.05) {
    list(col = "grey10", sym = " \u2020")
  } else {
    list(col = "grey10", sym = "")
  }
}

# Returns list(col, lbl) for use as element_markdown subtitle
format_sig_label <- function(pv, pfdr = NA, eta2 = NA) {
  s <- make_sig_label(pv, pfdr)
  parts <- character(0)
  if (!is.na(eta2)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("η²<sub>p</sub> = ", formatC(eta2, format = "f", digits = 2)))
  parts <- c(parts, paste0("*p* = ", formatC(pv, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  if (!is.na(pfdr)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("*FDR* = ", formatC(pfdr, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  list(col = s$col, lbl = paste0(paste(parts, collapse = ", "), s$sym))
}

# Save publication figures as SVG
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path("figs", paste0(name, ".svg")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in", device = svglite)
  invisible(plot)
}

# Export table DATA as CSV to tables/data/ (kept separate from the manuscript-ready
# .docx deliverables in tables/, so re-knitting never muddies the deliverables folder).
save_table <- function(df, name, caption = NULL) {
  dir.create(file.path("tables", "data"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  path <- file.path("tables", "data", paste0(name, ".csv"))
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(caption)) message(sprintf("Exported: %s - %s", path, caption))
  invisible(df)
}

# --- Manuscript regression-table formatters (used for the exported files only;
# on-screen HTML tables keep their full raw detail). Polished row labels via
# label_roi / label_cog and consistent, publication-style column names.

# Canonical row ordering for exported tables, matching the figures: whole-subcortex
# composite first, then striatum -> pallidum -> midbrain; Overall domain first.
roi_table_order <- c("Subcortex_Total", roi_order_conceptual)
cog_table_order <- c("Overall_Efficiency", "SocialCog_Efficiency",
                     "Memory_Efficiency", "Executive_Efficiency", "Complex_Efficiency")

.id_order_key <- function(col, values) {
  ord <- switch(col, ROI = roi_table_order, Cog.Domain = cog_table_order, NULL)
  if (is.null(ord)) as.integer(factor(values)) else match(as.character(values), ord)
}

# Reorder rows by the canonical order of the id column(s), so regions/domains are
# figure-consistent across every table (rather than p-value ordered).
.reg_order <- function(df, id_cols) {
  keys <- lapply(id_cols, function(col) .id_order_key(col, df[[col]]))
  df[do.call(order, keys), , drop = FALSE]
}

# Build the polished id column(s) (e.g. Region, or Region + Domain) for a table.
# id_cols/id_names are character vectors; id_funs a list of labelers (or one function).
.reg_ids <- function(df, id_cols, id_names, id_funs) {
  if (is.function(id_funs)) id_funs <- list(id_funs)
  ids <- Map(function(col, fn) fn(as.character(df[[col]])), id_cols, id_funs)
  out <- as.data.frame(ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  names(out) <- id_names
  out
}

# Smooth-term GAMM effects -> [Region/Domain ...] | edf | F | η²p | p | FDR
reg_table <- function(df, id_cols = "ROI", id_names = "Region", id_funs = list(label_roi)) {
  df  <- .reg_order(df, id_cols)
  out <- .reg_ids(df, id_cols, id_names, id_funs)
  out$edf      <- round(df$edf, 2)
  out$F        <- round(df$statistic, 2)
  out[["η²p"]] <- round(df$partial_eta2, 3)
  out$p        <- signif(df$p.value, 3)
  if ("p.fdr" %in% names(df)) out$FDR <- signif(df$p.fdr, 3)
  out
}

# Parametric contrast (e.g. PS - TD) -> [Region/Domain ...] | β | SE | t | [Cohen's d] | p | FDR
group_table <- function(df, id_cols = "ROI", id_names = "Region", id_funs = list(label_roi)) {
  df  <- .reg_order(df, id_cols)
  out <- .reg_ids(df, id_cols, id_names, id_funs)
  out[["β"]] <- round(df$estimate, 4)
  out$SE     <- round(df$std.error, 4)
  out$t      <- round(df$statistic, 2)
  if ("cohens_d" %in% names(df)) out[["Cohen's d"]] <- round(df$cohens_d, 3)
  out$p      <- signif(df$p.value, 3)
  if ("p.fdr" %in% names(df)) out$FDR <- signif(df$p.fdr, 3)
  out
}

# p-value formatter for exported tables ("<0.001" for very small p)
.fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "-", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))

# --- General combined regression-table plan for the age-family GAMMs -------------
# tidy_gam_full: one row per model term (smooth terms report edf/F; parametric terms
# report beta/SE/t), each with partial eta-squared. The random-effect smooth s(subid)
# and the intercept are dropped. eta_squared keys parametric terms by bare factor
# name, so each term is matched to its eta by longest-prefix.
tidy_gam_full <- function(model) {
  smth <- broom::tidy(model, parametric = FALSE) %>% dplyr::filter(term != "s(subid)") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(term, estimate = NA_real_, std.error = NA_real_, edf,
                     stat_type = "F", statistic, p.value)
  para <- broom::tidy(model, parametric = TRUE)  %>% dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(term, estimate, std.error, edf = NA_real_,
                     stat_type = "t", statistic, p.value)
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(smth, para)
  eta <- as.data.frame(effectsize::eta_squared(model, partial = TRUE, verbose = FALSE))
  out$eta2 <- vapply(out$term, function(tm) {
    hit <- eta$Parameter[eta$Parameter == tm | startsWith(tm, eta$Parameter)]
    if (!length(hit)) NA_real_ else eta$Eta2_partial[match(hit[which.max(nchar(hit))], eta$Parameter)]
  }, numeric(1))
  out$N <- length(model$y)
  out
}

# Human labels for model terms (unknown terms fall through unchanged and are dropped
# by the term_levels filter in reg_supp_table).
reg_term_labels <- c(
  "s(age)"                = "Age (smooth)",
  "s(age):osexFemale"     = "Age x Sex (smooth)",
  "s(age):ostudy.groupPS" = "Age x Group (smooth)",
  "sexFemale"             = "Sex (F - M)",
  "osex.L"                = "Sex (F - M)",
  "study.groupPS"         = "Group (PS - TD)",
  "ostudy.group.L"        = "Group (PS - TD)")
label_term <- function(t) ifelse(is.na(reg_term_labels[t]), t, unname(reg_term_labels[t]))

# reg_supp_table: build one combined regression supplement (grouped by Region) for a
# set of ROI models + the whole-subcortex composite. FDR is corrected across the
# primary ROIs within each term; the composite is reference-only (no FDR). Writes a
# flat CSV (with N) and a grouped Word .docx (N in the footnote); returns the flextable.
reg_supp_table <- function(models, global_model, name, caption, term_levels) {
  tidy_set <- function(mods, comp) mods %>%
    mutate(.t = map(model, tidy_gam_full)) %>% select(ROI, .t) %>% tidyr::unnest(.t) %>%
    mutate(is_comp = comp)
  prim <- tidy_set(models, FALSE) %>%
    group_by(term) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>% ungroup()
  comp <- tidy_set(global_model, TRUE) %>% mutate(FDR = NA_real_)

  fmt <- bind_rows(prim, comp) %>%
    mutate(Region = factor(label_roi(as.character(ROI)),
                           levels = label_roi(c("Subcortex_Total", roi_order_conceptual))),
           Effect = factor(label_term(term), levels = term_levels)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Effect)) %>%
    arrange(Region, Effect) %>%
    transmute(
      Region, Term = as.character(Effect), N,
      `β (SE)`  = ifelse(is.na(estimate), "", sprintf("%.4f (%.4f)", estimate, std.error)),
      edf       = ifelse(is.na(edf), "", sprintf("%.2f", edf)),
      Statistic = sprintf("%s = %.2f", stat_type, statistic),
      `η²p`     = sprintf("%.3f", eta2),
      p         = .fmt_p(p.value),
      FDR       = .fmt_p(FDR))

  save_table(fmt, name, caption)
  n_obs  <- length(models$model[[1]]$y)
  n_subj <- dplyr::n_distinct(models$model[[1]]$model$subid)
  foot <- sprintf(paste0(
    "N = %d imaging sessions from %d participants for all models. The whole-subcortex composite ",
    "is shown for reference and is not part of the FDR correction."),
    n_obs, n_subj)
  # Word table: Region as a bold first column (name on each block's first row only,
  # blank below) with clean block separators. Avoids vertical-merge render artifacts.
  body   <- dplyr::select(fmt, -N)
  bounds <- cumsum(rle(as.character(body$Region))$lengths)
  first  <- c(1, head(bounds, -1) + 1)
  body$Region <- ifelse(seq_len(nrow(body)) %in% first, as.character(body$Region), "")
  bd <- officer::fp_border(color = "grey55", width = 1)
  ft <- flextable::flextable(body) %>%
    flextable::border_remove() %>%
    flextable::bold(j = "Region", part = "body") %>%
    flextable::bold(part = "header") %>%
    flextable::hline_top(part = "header", border = bd) %>%
    flextable::hline_bottom(part = "header", border = bd) %>%
    flextable::hline(i = bounds, part = "body", border = bd) %>%
    flextable::add_footer_lines(foot) %>%
    flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "footer") %>%
    flextable::autofit()
  # Final APA .docx tables are built separately; this flextable is for the HTML preview only.
  ft
}
```

# Data Loading and Preparation

## Load de-identified public data

This public version loads the released de-identified analysis dataset
(`data_public/qsm_iron_psychosis_analysis_data.csv`) in place of the raw source files and the
image-processing / quality-control pipeline used in the primary analysis. The released data are
the final analytic sample (263 sessions from 183 participants), with image quality control and
all participant exclusions already applied, so no filtering is performed here. This version
reproduces all reported statistical analyses, tables, and figures.

```{r load_public_data}
# Output directories for saved figures/tables (created on a fresh clone).
dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path("tables", "data"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pub <- readr::read_csv("data_public/qsm_iron_psychosis_analysis_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

med_cols <- c("med_any_psych", "med_stimulant", "med_antidepressant", "med_any_ap",
              "med_mood_stab", "med_anxiolytic", "iron_supplement")

# Analysis dataframe: map released IDs to the internal names the downstream code expects,
# add a subject key (bblid = participant id for the public release), and drop the medication
# columns here (re-attached downstream via `med_harmonized`, mirroring the original join).
df <- pub %>%
  dplyr::rename(subid = participant_id, sesid = session) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bblid = subid) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(med_cols)) %>%
  prep_phenotypes()

# Subject-level harmonized medication frame (one row per participant), matching the object the
# Table 1 and medication-sensitivity chunks expect (they join it on `bblid`).
med_harmonized <- pub %>%
  dplyr::transmute(bblid = participant_id, dataset,
                   dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(med_cols))) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(bblid, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Loaded public data: %d sessions, %d participants (PS %d / TD %d)\n",
            nrow(df), dplyr::n_distinct(df$subid),
            dplyr::n_distinct(df$subid[df$study.group == "PS"]),
            dplyr::n_distinct(df$subid[df$study.group == "TD"])))
```

# Sample Characteristics

```{r sample_characteristics}
# Med-class flags shown in Table 1 (combined EF + MOTIVE, harmonized subject-level)
med_tab_vars <- c("Any psychotropic", "Stimulant", "Antidepressant",
                  "Antipsychotic", "Mood stabilizer", "Anxiolytic", "Iron supplement")

# Collapse to one row per subject (first/baseline visit) for demographics, then
# attach harmonized medication flags (any use across visits) keyed on bblid.
df_subj <- df %>%
  group_by(subid) %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  summarise(
    bblid        = first(bblid),
    Group        = first(study.group),
    Dataset      = factor(first(dataset)),
    Sex          = first(sex),
    Age_Baseline = first(age),
    Age_Mean     = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_Visits     = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    med_harmonized %>%
      distinct(bblid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      transmute(
        bblid,
        `Any psychotropic` = med_any_psych,
        `Stimulant`        = med_stimulant,
        `Antidepressant`   = med_antidepressant,
        `Antipsychotic`    = med_any_ap,
        `Mood stabilizer`  = med_mood_stab,
        `Anxiolytic`       = med_anxiolytic,
        `Iron supplement`  = iron_supplement
      ),
    by = "bblid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(med_tab_vars),
                ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))))

# Table 1: demographics + medication use by clinical group, with significance tests.
# Medications were harmonized across cohorts and endorsed almost exclusively by PS.
tbl1 <- tbl_summary(
  df_subj,
  by       = Group,
  include  = c(Sex, Age_Baseline, Age_Mean, N_Visits, all_of(med_tab_vars)),
  label    = list(
    Sex          ~ "Sex",
    Age_Baseline ~ "Age at first visit (years)",
    Age_Mean     ~ "Mean age across visits (years)",
    N_Visits     ~ "Number of visits"
  ),
  type      = all_of(med_tab_vars) ~ "dichotomous",
  value     = all_of(med_tab_vars) ~ "Yes",
  statistic = list(
    all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd}); [{min}-{max}]",
    all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
  ),
  digits  = list(all_continuous() ~ 1),
  missing = "no"
) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      Age_Baseline ~ "wilcox.test",
      Age_Mean     ~ "wilcox.test",
      N_Visits     ~ "wilcox.test",
      Sex          ~ "fisher.test",
      all_of(med_tab_vars) ~ "fisher.test"
    ),
    pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 3)
  ) %>%
  add_overall(col_label = "**Overall\nN = {N}**") %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("stat_1", "stat_2") ~ "**Clinical Group**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Sample Characteristics**") %>%
  modify_footnote(all_stat_cols() ~
    "Medication classes are harmonized across the EF and MOTIVE cohorts (any use across visits).")
tbl1
# Table 1 deliverable is the hand-formatted Table_1_Sample_Characteristics_v2.docx;
# no auto-export here (it previously wrote a stale Helvetica table1_demographics.docx).

# Age distribution by dataset, sex, and group
ggplot(df, aes(x = age, fill = study.group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.75, position = "identity") +
  facet_grid(~sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors,
                    labels = c("TD" = "Typically Developing", "PS" = "Psychosis Spectrum")) +
  labs(
    title = "Age Distribution by Dataset, Sex, and Clinical Group",
    x    = "Age (years)",
    y    = "Density",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

```

# Fit developmental models
## Global composite models
```{r global_composite_models, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
# Fit global subcortex models for all major analyses - outputs are used as needed downstream.
# All models share a common GAMM structure for consistency and comparability of age effects:
# - Penalized thin-plate regression spline for age to capture nonlinear developmental trajectories while penalizing overfitting.
# - Random intercept for subid to account for repeated measures nested within subject.


# 1. Age + group main effects (also used for group differences)
global_comp_age_models <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = rois$global, names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch({
      d <- cur_data()
      mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k = 6) + sex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
          method = "REML", data = d)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Age x sex interaction
global_comp_agesex_models <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = rois$global, names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch({
      d <- cur_data()
      mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k = 6) + s(age, by = osex, k = 4) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
          method = "REML", data = d)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Age x group interaction
global_comp_agegroup_models <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = rois$global, names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch({
      d <- cur_data()
      mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k = 6) + s(age, by = ostudy.group, k = 4) + osex + ostudy.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
          method = "REML", data = d)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Sub-region models
```{r roi_models, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
# Fit ROI-wise models for all major analyses using the same workflow as the global composites above. Outputs are used as needed downstream.

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(rois$primary), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM")

# 1. Age + group main effects (also used for group differences)
age_main_models <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
    mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age) + sex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
    error = function(e) NULL)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

# 2. Age x sex interaction
age_sex_models <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
    mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k = 6) + s(age, by = osex, k = 4) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
    error = function(e) NULL)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

# 3. Age x group interaction
age_group_ps_models <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(QSM)) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
    mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k = 6) + s(age, by = ostudy.group, k = 4) + osex + ostudy.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
    error = function(e) NULL)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))
```

# Regression Tables (Supplementary)

Consolidated regression readouts for the three age-family models (one row-block per region). For
each model we report every term: the age smooth and any interaction smooth with edf and F, plus the
parametric sex and group effects with beta (SE) and t, each with partial eta-squared. FDR is
corrected across the primary ROI set within each term; the whole-subcortex composite is shown for
reference (not part of the FDR family).

```{r regression_supp_tables}
.sc <- function(m) m %>% filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total")

# 1. Age model: QSM ~ s(age) + sex + group
reg_supp_table(age_main_models, .sc(global_comp_age_models),
  "supptable_age_model_regression", "Supp Table: age model (age + sex + group) by ROI",
  c("Age (smooth)", "Sex (F - M)", "Group (PS - TD)"))

# 2. Age x sex model: QSM ~ s(age) + s(age, by = sex) + sex + group
reg_supp_table(age_sex_models, .sc(global_comp_agesex_models),
  "supptable_agesex_model_regression", "Supp Table: age x sex model by ROI",
  c("Age (smooth)", "Age x Sex (smooth)", "Sex (F - M)", "Group (PS - TD)"))

# 3. Age x group model: QSM ~ s(age) + s(age, by = group) + sex + group
reg_supp_table(age_group_ps_models, .sc(global_comp_agegroup_models),
  "supptable_agegroup_model_regression", "Supp Table: age x group model by ROI",
  c("Age (smooth)", "Age x Group (smooth)", "Sex (F - M)", "Group (PS - TD)"))
```


# Reporting
# Age Effects

All analyses use **TD vs PS**, pooled across EF and MOTIVE. No cohort covariate is included since sensitivity analyses confirmed no significant dataset main effect across any ROI (all p > 0.25). 

All models use a GAMM structure with a penalized thin-plate regression spline (mgcv default) for age and a random intercept for subid to account for repeated measures. This allows us to flexibly capture non-linear developmental trajectories without overfitting, while properly modeling the longitudinal data structure.

## Global

```{r global_age_composites}
global_age_comp_results <- global_comp_age_models %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, tidy_gam)) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(term == "s(age)") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

global_age_comp_results %>%
  select(ROI, edf, F = statistic, partial_eta2, p.value) %>%
  kable(caption = "Age effect - global composite") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(global_age_comp_results$p.value < 0.05), bold = TRUE, color = "darkred")

sig_age_comp <- global_age_comp_results %>% filter(p.value < 0.05) %>% pull(ROI)
if (length(sig_age_comp) > 0) {
  plots <- map(sig_age_comp, ~ partial_resid_plot(
    global_comp_age_models %>% filter(ROI == .x) %>% pull(model) %>% .[[1]],
    term = "age", group.term = "subid", plot.title = label_roi(.x),
    xlabel = "Age (years)", ylabel = "Susceptibility (ppm)",
    show.data = TRUE, add.intercept = TRUE
  ))
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = min(3, length(plots)))
}
```

## Region-wise

```{r age_effects_tdps, cache=TRUE, dependson="roi_models", fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)
```

# Group Differences

## Global

```{r global_grpdiff_composites}
# Reuses global_comp_age_models (QSM ~ s(age) + sex + study.group)
global_grpdiff_comp_results <- global_comp_age_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(
    tidy = map(model, ~ {
      n_grp    <- distinct(.x$model, subid, study.group) %>% count(study.group)
      n_td     <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "TD"]
      n_ps     <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "PS"]
      resid_df <- .x$df.residual
      broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE) %>%
        filter(str_detect(term, "study.groupPS")) %>%
        mutate(
          cohens_d       = statistic * sqrt(1 / n_td + 1 / n_ps),
          partial_omega2 = pmax(0, (statistic^2 - 1) / (statistic^2 + resid_df))
        )
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)),
         p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr"))

global_grpdiff_comp_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  kable(caption = "TD vs PS group differences - global composites") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")) %>%
  row_spec(which(global_grpdiff_comp_results$p.value < 0.05), bold = TRUE, color = "darkred")

# --- Global Plot Prep ---
sub_mod_gam <- global_comp_age_models %>% filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total") %>% pull(model) %>% .[[1]]

pred_sub <- predict_response(sub_mod_gam, terms = "study.group", margin = "empirical") %>% 
  as.data.frame()

stats_row <- global_grpdiff_comp_results %>% filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total")
sig_label <- sprintf("italic(d) == %.2f * ',' ~ italic(p) == %.3f", 
                     stats_row$cohens_d, stats_row$p.value)

# --- Global Plot ---
p_global <- ggplot(pred_sub, aes(x = x, y = predicted, fill = x)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "grey30", stroke = 1) +
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("TD", "PS")),
    annotations = sig_label,
    parse = TRUE,
    y_position = max(pred_sub$conf.high) * 1.05, 
    tip_length = 0.02,
    vjust = -0.2,
    textsize = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors,
                    labels = c("TD" = "Typically Developing", "PS" = "Psychosis Spectrum")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) +
  labs(title = "Global subcortical", y = "Adjusted Susceptibility (ppm)", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Region-wise

```{r group_differences_tdps}
group_diff_tdps_results <- age_main_models %>%
  mutate(
    tidy = map(model, ~ {
      mod_gam  <- .x
      resid_df <- mod_gam$df.residual
      n_grp    <- distinct(mod_gam$model, subid, study.group) %>% count(study.group)
      n_td     <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "TD"]
      n_ps     <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "PS"]

      broom::tidy(mod_gam, parametric = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(
          partial_omega2 = pmax(0, (statistic^2 - 1) / (statistic^2 + resid_df)),
          cohens_d = if_else(
            str_detect(term, "study.group"),
            statistic * sqrt(1 / n_td + 1 / n_ps),
            NA_real_
          )
        )
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "study.group")) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

# Group differences are exported in the consolidated age-model regression supplement.
group_diff_tdps_results %>%
  present_results()

# --- ROI-wise predictions: same ggeffects pipeline as global ---
ps.means <- age_main_models %>%
  mutate(
    preds = map(model, ~ {
      predict_response(.x, terms = "study.group", margin = "empirical") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rename(study.group = x, QSM_mean = predicted,
               QSM_lower = conf.low, QSM_upper = conf.high)
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(preds)

ps.means_sig <- ps.means %>%
  left_join(
    group_diff_tdps_results %>%
      select(ROI, grp_p = p.value, grp_fdr = p.fdr, cohens_d),
    by = "ROI"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = case_when(grp_fdr < 0.05 ~ "**", grp_p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""),
    ROI = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_conceptual)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ROI))

# Per-ROI annotation: d and significance, placed above the higher CI
roi_annot <- ps.means_sig %>%
  group_by(ROI, grp_p, grp_fdr, cohens_d, sig_label) %>%
  summarise(y_top = max(QSM_upper), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("italic(d)==%.2f%s",
                    cohens_d,
                    ifelse(sig_label != "", paste0("~'", sig_label, "'"), ""))
  )

p_roi <- ggplot(ps.means_sig, aes(x = ROI, y = QSM_mean, fill = study.group)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = QSM_lower, ymax = QSM_upper),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                width = 0.1, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "grey30", stroke = 1,

  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors,
                    labels = c("TD" = "Typically Developing", "PS" = "Psychosis Spectrum")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = roi_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Adjusted Susceptibility (ppm)", fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

# Combine: collect shared legend at bottom
final_fig <- (p_global + p_roi +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.5), guides = "collect")) +

    title = "TD vs. Psychosis Spectrum: Age-Adjusted Subcortical Iron",

    theme = theme(

print(final_fig)
```

### Divergence Onset: Computation

Using the ordered-factor difference smooth `s(age):ostudy.groupPS`, we ask two
complementary questions at each ROI:

1. **Derivative onset** - at what age does the *rate* of TD-PS divergence first
   become credibly non-zero? This captures when the "insult" begins.
2. **Level onset** - at what age has enough divergence *accumulated* for the
   overall TD-PS gap to become credibly non-zero?

Both use simultaneous 95 % confidence intervals across the full age range (not
pointwise), so the family-wise error rate is controlled.

```{r age_group_divergence, cache=TRUE, dependson="age_by_group"}
smooth_label <- "s(age):ostudy.groupPS"

# Compute total TD-PS difference (parametric offset + age-varying smooth)
# using the lpmatrix difference: Xp(PS) - Xp(TD) cancels all shared terms
compute_divergence <- function(mod, roi_name, n_pts = 200, n_sim = 10000) {

  # Trim to 1st-99th percentile of observed ages to avoid boundary instability
  age_range  <- quantile(mod$model$age, c(0.01, 0.99))
  age_seq    <- seq(age_range[1], age_range[2], length.out = n_pts)
  grp_levels <- levels(mod$model$ostudy.group)

  # Prediction grids - identical except for group
  base <- data.frame(age = age_seq, osex = mod$model$osex[1],
                     subid = mod$model$subid[1])
  nd_PS <- cbind(base, ostudy.group = ordered("PS", levels = grp_levels))
  nd_TD <- cbind(base, ostudy.group = ordered("TD", levels = grp_levels))

  # Difference in lpmatrices - shared terms cancel, only group columns survive
  Xp_diff <- predict(mod, nd_PS, type = "lpmatrix") -
             predict(mod, nd_TD, type = "lpmatrix")

  beta <- coef(mod)
  Vp   <- vcov(mod, unconditional = TRUE)

  # --- Point estimates ---
  total_diff <- as.numeric(Xp_diff %*% beta)
  total_se   <- sqrt(rowSums((Xp_diff %*% Vp) * Xp_diff))

  # Simultaneous CI (simulation-based critical value)
  sim0    <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_sim, mu = rep(0, length(beta)), Sigma = Vp) #simulate from multivariate normal distrubition
  sim_dev <- Xp_diff %*% t(sim0)# n_pts x n_sim
  sim_std <- sweep(sim_dev, 1, total_se, "/")
  crit_val <- quantile(apply(abs(sim_std), 2, max), 0.95)

  sm <- tibble(age = age_seq, .estimate = total_diff, .se = total_se,
               .lower_ci = total_diff - crit_val * total_se,
               .upper_ci = total_diff + crit_val * total_se,
               ROI = roi_name)

  # Level onset (simultaneous CI excludes zero)
  level_sig   <- sm %>% filter(.lower_ci > 0 | .upper_ci < 0)
  level_onset <- if (nrow(level_sig) > 0) min(level_sig$age) else NA_real_

  # Derivative onset (smooth-only - parametric derivative = 0)
  deriv <- derivatives(mod, select = smooth_label, n = n_pts,
                       unconditional = TRUE, interval = "simultaneous")
  deriv$ROI <- roi_name
  deriv_sig   <- deriv %>% filter(.lower_ci > 0 | .upper_ci < 0)
  deriv_onset <- if (nrow(deriv_sig) > 0) min(deriv_sig$age) else NA_real_

  # Meaningful difference thresholds: Cohen's d > .1 or .2 
  grp_var <- mod$model$ostudy.group
  qsm_response <- model.response(mod$model)
  grp_sds <- tapply(qsm_response, grp_var, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  grp_ns  <- tapply(qsm_response, grp_var, length)
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(sum((grp_ns - 1) * grp_sds^2) / sum(grp_ns - 1))
  rope_d1  <- 0.1 * pooled_sd   # d = 0.1 (low threshold/very small effect)
  rope_d2  <- 0.2 * pooled_sd   # d = 0.2 (small effect threshold)

  # --- Posterior onset distributions ---
  beta_draws  <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_sim, mu = beta, Sigma = Vp)
  post_curves <- Xp_diff %*% t(beta_draws)
  effect_dir  <- sign(total_diff[n_pts]) # expected direction

  # Find the age of permanent group diffs beyond a given cohen's d threshold
  find_onset <- function(curve, thresh) {
    directed <- curve * effect_dir
    below <- which(directed <= thresh)
    if (length(below) == 0) return(age_seq[1])
    last_below <- max(below)
    if (last_below >= n_pts) return(NA_real_)
    age_seq[last_below + 1]
  }

  # Level onset per draw at both ROPE thresholds
  post_onset_d1 <- apply(post_curves, 2, find_onset, thresh = rope_d1)
  post_onset_d2 <- apply(post_curves, 2, find_onset, thresh = rope_d2)

  # 90 % credible intervals
  ci_lo <- 0.05; ci_hi <- 0.95

  list(
    summary = tibble(
      ROI = roi_name,
      pooled_sd       = round(pooled_sd, 4),
      rope_d1         = round(rope_d1, 4),
      rope_d2         = round(rope_d2, 4),
      level_onset_ci  = round(level_onset, 1),
      deriv_onset_ci  = round(deriv_onset, 1),
      # d = 0.1
      d1_med = round(median(post_onset_d1, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d1_lo  = round(quantile(post_onset_d1, ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d1_hi  = round(quantile(post_onset_d1, ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d1_pct_no = round(100 * mean(is.na(post_onset_d1)), 1),
      # d = 0.2
      d2_med = round(median(post_onset_d2, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d2_lo  = round(quantile(post_onset_d2, ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d2_hi  = round(quantile(post_onset_d2, ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      d2_pct_no = round(100 * mean(is.na(post_onset_d2)), 1)
    ),
    smooth          = sm,
    deriv           = deriv,
    post_onset_d1   = post_onset_d1,
    post_onset_d2   = post_onset_d2
  )
}

# Run for ROI-level models
# Seed the posterior / simultaneous-CI simulations so onset CIs are reproducible
# across knits (manuscript text must match Supplementary Table 2 exactly).
set.seed(20260716)
roi_divergence <- age_group_ps_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(div = map2(model, ROI, compute_divergence)) %>%
  pull(div)

# Run for Subcortex_Total
sub_mod <- global_comp_agegroup_models %>%
  filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total", !map_lgl(model, is.null))
if (nrow(sub_mod) > 0) {
  roi_divergence <- c(roi_divergence,
                      list(compute_divergence(sub_mod$model[[1]], "Subcortex_Total")))
}

# Assemble summary table
divergence_table <- bind_rows(map(roi_divergence, "summary")) %>%
  mutate(ROI_Label = label_roi(ROI)) %>%
  arrange(deriv_onset_ci)

# Full curve data for Figure 2 Panel C
divergence_smooth <- bind_rows(map(roi_divergence, "smooth"))
divergence_deriv  <- bind_rows(map(roi_divergence, "deriv"))

save_table(divergence_table, "table4b_divergence_onset", "Divergence onset timing (full data)")
```

### Divergence Onset: Tables & Distributions

Each posterior draw yields a full TD-PS difference curve. For each draw we take the
the earliest age after which the difference permanently exceeds a cohen's d threshold of either .1 or .2.

All credible intervals are 90 %

```{r age_group_divergence_posterior, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Reference only (NOT a manuscript table): compares divergence timing across
# effect-size cutoffs (ROPE Cohen's d = 0.1 vs d = 0.2), all regions.
divergence_table %>%
  select(ROI_Label,
         d1_med, d1_lo, d1_hi,
         d2_med, d2_lo, d2_hi) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Region",
                       "Median", "5 %", "95 %",
                       "Median", "5 %", "95 %"),
        caption = "Divergence timing across effect-size cutoffs (ROPE d = 0.1 vs d = 0.2, 10 000 draws, 90 % CI, years) - reference, not a manuscript table",
        digits = 1) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "d = 0.1 (years)" = 3,

# Supplementary Table 2 (the official, reported-in-text table): divergence timing

  select(ROI_Label, d2_med, d2_lo, d2_hi) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Region", "Median", "5 %", "95 %"),
        caption = "Supplementary Table 2. Posterior divergence timing (10 000 draws, 90 % CI, ROPE d = 0.2, years)",
        digits = 1) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# Build long-format onset data for density plots
post_onset_df <- map_dfr(roi_divergence, function(div) {
  roi <- div$summary$ROI
  bind_rows(
    tibble(ROI = roi, onset_type = "d = 0.1", onset_age = div$post_onset_d1),

}) %>%
  filter(!is.na(onset_age)) %>%

# Keep ROIs where >= 50 % of draws have a defined onset for at least one metric
```

### Longitudinal Robustness: Within- vs Between-Person Developmental Slopes

Mixed-effects models represent age with a single term that blends within-person
(longitudinal) and between-person (cross-sectional) variation. In the participants with
repeat visits we can separate the two: age is split into each subject's mean age
(between-person) and their deviation across visits (within-person) -- a within-between
(Mundlak) decomposition. Because this decomposition requires additive linear age terms,
these models are fit as linear mixed models (lme4), a linear approximation of the
developmental slope complementary to the primary GAMMs. For each region we read the
between- and within-person age slope separately for each group, asking whether the iron
increase and the TD-PS divergence hold *within individuals* -- a stronger test that the
effects are genuinely developmental rather than stable between-person differences. Because
the within-person contrast comes from a small subset over a narrow age range, effect size
(the magnitude of the slope), not statistical significance, is the primary readout.

```{r within-between-analysis, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
# How much longitudinal data do we have?
visit_counts <- df %>% count(subid, name = "n_vis")
n_subj  <- nrow(visit_counts)
n_long  <- sum(visit_counts$n_vis >= 2)
age_dev <- df %>% filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  group_by(subid) %>% mutate(age_wi = age - mean(age)) %>% ungroup()

disaggregation_design <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Subjects", "Subjects with >= 2 visits", "% longitudinal",
             "Within-person age deviation (yr)"),
  Value  = c(as.character(n_subj),
             as.character(n_long),
             sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * n_long / n_subj),
             sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", min(age_dev$age_wi), max(age_dev$age_wi)))
)

# Group-specific between/within age slopes. The between/within (Mundlak) split
# requires additive linear age terms, so these are LINEAR mixed models (a linear
# approximation complementary to the primary GAMMs); each group's slope is read
# off the interaction model by re-referencing study.group.
disag_rois <- c(rois$global, rois$primary)

group_slopes <- purrr::map_dfr(disag_rois, function(roi) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[roi]]), !is.na(age)) %>%
    mutate(QSM = .data[[roi]]) %>%
    group_by(subid) %>%
    mutate(age_bw = mean(age), age_wi = age - age_bw) %>%
    ungroup()

  read_slopes <- function(ref) {
    d2 <- d %>% mutate(grp = relevel(factor(study.group), ref = ref))
    m  <- lmerTest::lmer(QSM ~ age_bw * grp + age_wi * grp + sex + (1 | subid), data = d2)
    tb <- broom.mixed::tidy(m, effects = "fixed")
    g  <- function(tm, col) { v <- tb[[col]][tb$term == tm]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }
    list(bw = g("age_bw", "estimate"), bw_p = g("age_bw", "p.value"),
         wi = g("age_wi", "estimate"), wi_p = g("age_wi", "p.value"))
  }
  td <- read_slopes("TD"); ps <- read_slopes("PS")
  tibble(ROI = roi,
         TD_bw = td$bw, TD_bw_p = td$bw_p, PS_bw = ps$bw, PS_bw_p = ps$bw_p,
         TD_wi = td$wi, TD_wi_p = td$wi_p, PS_wi = ps$wi, PS_wi_p = ps$wi_p)
})

# Slopes x 1000 (units of 10^-3 ppm / year)
group_slopes_x3 <- group_slopes %>%
  mutate(Region = label_roi(ROI),
         across(c(TD_bw, PS_bw, TD_wi, PS_wi), ~ .x * 1000)) %>%
  select(Region, TD_bw, PS_bw, TD_wi, PS_wi, TD_bw_p, PS_bw_p, TD_wi_p, PS_wi_p)
save_table(group_slopes_x3, "table_within_between",
           "Group-specific between/within age slopes (x1000 ppm/yr)")

# --- Display: design descriptives ---
disaggregation_design %>%
  kable(caption = "Longitudinal information available for the within/between decomposition") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# --- Display: group-specific slopes (x1000 ppm/yr) ---
group_slopes_x3 %>%
  transmute(Region, `Btwn TD` = TD_bw, `Btwn PS` = PS_bw,
            `Wthn TD` = TD_wi, `Wthn PS` = PS_wi) %>%
  present_results(highlight_sig = FALSE)

# --- Figure: group-specific between/within slopes ---
gs_long <- group_slopes %>%
  transmute(Region = factor(label_roi(ROI), levels = label_roi(c(rois$global, rois$primary))),
            `Between-person: TD` = TD_bw * 1000, `Between-person: PS` = PS_bw * 1000,
            `Within-person: TD`  = TD_wi * 1000, `Within-person: PS`  = PS_wi * 1000) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Region, names_to = "key", values_to = "estimate") %>%
  separate(key, into = c("Component", "Group"), sep = ": ") %>%
  mutate(Component = factor(Component, levels = c("Between-person", "Within-person")),
         Group     = factor(Group, levels = c("TD", "PS")))

fig_within_between <- ggplot(gs_long, aes(x = Region, y = estimate, fill = Group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.65, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Component, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, labels = group_labels, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Age slope (" * 10^-3 * " ppm / year)"),
       title = "Group-specific developmental slopes",
       subtitle = "TD accumulate iron within-person; PS largely do not") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top", strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
fig_within_between
save_fig(fig_within_between, "suppfig_within_between", width = 9, height = 8)

rm(age_dev, visit_counts, gs_long)
```

# Regional Overview: Levels, Reliability, and Trajectories

A single overview of the analyzed regions (whole-subcortex composite first, then each primary
ROI): regional iron levels, test-retest reliability, and developmental trajectories. The
trajectory panels reuse the fitted developmental GAMMs (the same models behind the age-effect
results), plotting the age marginal effect with partial residuals - consistent with Figure 2.
Two versions are produced: a compact main-text candidate (trajectory small-multiples with the
ICC annotated in each panel) and a fuller supplementary version (levels -> test-retest -> trajectories).

```{r figure_regional_overview, fig.width=12, fig.height=15}
# Region order: whole-subcortex composite first, then primary ROIs (striatum -> midbrain)
region_order <- c("Subcortex_Total", "Ca", "Pu", "NAC", "Pallidum_Total",
                  "SN_Total", "VTA_Total", "RN", "STH")
region_labs  <- label_roi(region_order)

# --- Test-retest reliability (ICC) for the analyzed regions ------------------
reliability_rois <- c(rois$primary, rois$global)
df_longitudinal  <- df %>% group_by(subid) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>% ungroup()

calculate_icc <- function(data, roi) {
  model <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(roi, " ~ 1 + (1|subid)")), data = data)
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  vc$vcov[1] / sum(vc$vcov)
}

icc_results <- tibble(
  ROI = reliability_rois,
  ICC = map_dbl(reliability_rois, ~ calculate_icc(df_longitudinal, .x))
) %>% arrange(desc(ICC))

# Test-retest data for subjects with exactly two timepoints
df_test_retest <- df_longitudinal %>%
  group_by(subid) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>% arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = row_number()) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(subid, timepoint, all_of(reliability_rois)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(reliability_rois), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = QSM, names_prefix = "Time_")

# Test-retest scatter for an arbitrary set of ROIs, with per-panel ICC annotation
test_retest_plot <- function(roi_set, plot_title, ncol = NULL) {
  dat <- df_test_retest %>%
    filter(ROI %in% roi_set) %>%
    mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = roi_set))
  icc_lab <- icc_results %>%
    filter(ROI %in% roi_set) %>%
    mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = roi_set),
           label = sprintf("ICC = %.2f", ICC))
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Time_1, y = Time_2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey75") +
    geom_text(data = icc_lab, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ ROI, scales = "free", ncol = ncol,
               labeller = as_labeller(roi_labels)) +
    labs(title = plot_title,
         x = "Time 1 Susceptibility (ppm)", y = "Time 2 Susceptibility (ppm)")
}

# --- (1) Regional iron levels: distribution per region (box plots) ----------
df_region <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(region_order), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(QSM)) %>%
  mutate(ROI = factor(label_roi(ROI), levels = region_labs))

p_levels <- ggplot(df_region, aes(ROI, QSM)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey90", color = "grey20", outlier.size = 0.5,
               outlier.alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(title = "Regional iron levels", x = NULL, y = "Susceptibility (ppm)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# --- (2) Developmental trajectories: reuse the fitted GAMMs (age marginal
# effect with partial residuals), whole subcortex first then primary ROIs -----
traj_models <- bind_rows(
  global_comp_age_models %>% filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total") %>% select(ROI, model),
  age_main_models %>% filter(ROI %in% setdiff(region_order, "Subcortex_Total")) %>%
    select(ROI, model)
) %>% mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = region_order)) %>% arrange(ROI)

base_traj <- map2(traj_models$model, as.character(traj_models$ROI), ~ partial_resid_plot(
  .x, term = "age", group.term = "subid", plot.title = label_roi(.y),
  xlabel = "Age (years)", ylabel = "Susceptibility (ppm)",
  show.data = TRUE, add.intercept = TRUE))

p_traj <- wrap_plots(base_traj, ncol = 3)

# --- (3) Test-retest scatter (Time 1 vs Time 2), Subcortex first ------------
p_icc_scatter <- test_retest_plot(region_order, "Test-retest reliability (Time 1 vs Time 2)",
                                  ncol = 3)

# --- Main-text candidate: trajectory grid with the ICC annotated in-panel ---
traj_icc <- map2(base_traj, as.character(traj_models$ROI), function(p, r) {
  icc <- icc_results$ICC[icc_results$ROI == r]
  p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("ICC = %.2f", icc),
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.4, color = "grey25")
})
fig_regional_main <- wrap_plots(traj_icc, ncol = 3)
fig_regional_main
save_fig(fig_regional_main, "fig_regional_overview_main", width = 11, height = 10)

# --- Supplementary: levels -> reliability -> trajectories -------------------
# Direct nesting keeps panel widths aligned across A-C (wrap_elements would break
# that). Tag the trajectory grid's first panel so the 3x3 block reads as a single
# Panel C instead of auto-tagging each sub-panel C, D, E, ...
traj_tag <- base_traj
traj_tag[[1]] <- traj_tag[[1]] + labs(tag = "C")
p_traj_c <- wrap_plots(traj_tag, ncol = 3)

suppfig_regional <- (p_levels + labs(tag = "A")) /
                    (p_icc_scatter + labs(tag = "B")) /
                    p_traj_c +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.4, 1.1, 1.8))
suppfig_regional <- suppfig_regional &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
suppfig_regional
save_fig(suppfig_regional, "suppfig_regional_overview", width = 12, height = 18)

# Developmental GAMMs no longer needed after this figure.
rm(global_comp_age_models, age_main_models)
```

# Disorder-Cognition Relationships {.tabset}

Establishes the total effect of diagnosis on cognition (prerequisite for mediation).
Runs on all subjects (TD + PS).

## Main Effects

```{r dx_cog_main_effects, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
df_cog <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency), 
               names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score")

dx_cog_main_models <- df_cog %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(mgcv::gam(
      Cog.Score ~ s(age, k=6) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
          method = "REML",
          data = cur_data()
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dx_cog_main_results <- dx_cog_main_models %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ tidy_gam(.x, parametric = TRUE))) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "study.group")) %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, p.value)

save_table(group_table(dx_cog_main_results, "Cog.Domain", "Domain", label_cog),
           "supptable3_dx_cognition", "Supp Table 3: Diagnosis-cognition associations")

dx_cog_main_results %>%
  present_results()
# dx_cog_main_models freed in dx_cog_main_viz after cog_grp_preds is built
```

```{r dx_cog_main_viz, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Marginal means via ggeffects - same pipeline as the QSM group differences plot.
# Cohen's d uses unique subject counts per group (appropriate for mixed-model GAM).
cog_grp_preds <- dx_cog_main_models %>%
  mutate(
    preds = map(model, ~ {
      predict_response(.x, terms = "study.group", margin = "empirical") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rename(study.group = x, Cog_mean = predicted,
               Cog_lower = conf.low, Cog_upper = conf.high)
    }),
    cohens_d = map_dbl(model, ~ {
      n_grp <- distinct(.x$model, subid, study.group) %>% count(study.group)
      t_val <- broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE) %>%
        filter(str_detect(term, "study.group")) %>%
        pull(statistic)
      n_td <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "TD"]
      n_ps <- n_grp$n[n_grp$study.group == "PS"]
      t_val * sqrt(1 / n_td + 1 / n_ps)
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(preds) %>%
  left_join(dx_cog_main_results %>% select(Cog.Domain, p.value, p.fdr),
            by = "Cog.Domain") %>%
  mutate(Domain = label_cog(Cog.Domain))

# Per-domain annotation placed above the taller CI
cog_grp_annot <- cog_grp_preds %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain, Domain, cohens_d, p.value, p.fdr) %>%
  summarise(y_top = max(Cog_upper), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    # Match the Figure 3 B/C convention: * = FDR < .05, dagger = nominal p < .05
    sig_sym = case_when(p.fdr < 0.05 ~ "*", p.value < 0.05 ~ "†", TRUE ~ ""),
    label   = sprintf("italic(d)==%.2f%s", cohens_d,
                      ifelse(sig_sym != "", paste0("~'", sig_sym, "'"), ""))
  )

ggplot(cog_grp_preds, aes(x = study.group, y = Cog_mean, fill = study.group)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Cog_lower, ymax = Cog_upper),
                width = 0.1, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "grey30", stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(data = cog_grp_annot,
            aes(x = 1.5, y = y_top, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, parse = TRUE,
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, color = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~ Domain, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors,
                    labels = c("TD" = "Typically Developing", "PS" = "Psychosis Spectrum"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Adjusted Performance") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
# cog_grp_preds and cog_grp_annot kept - reused in figure_4_paper
rm(dx_cog_main_models)
```

# QSM-Cognition Relationships {.tabset}

Tests whether regional QSM predicts cognitive performance, controlling for age, sex, and group.
All subjects (TD + PS) are included.

## Region-wise

### Main effects

```{r qsm_cog_main_effects, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
df_qsm_cog <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(rois$primary), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency), 
               names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score")

qsm_cog_main_models <- df_qsm_cog %>%
  group_by(ROI, Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(mgcv::gam(
      Cog.Score ~ s(age) + s(QSM) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
          method = "REML",
          data = cur_data()
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

qsm_cog_main_results <- qsm_cog_main_models %>%
  mutate(
    tidy = map(model, ~ {
      mod_gam <- .x
      tidy.df <- broom::tidy(mod_gam, parametric = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(N = nrow(mod_gam$model)) %>%
        relocate(N, .after = term)
      eta2 <- effectsize::eta_squared(mod_gam, partial = TRUE) %>%
          select(Parameter, partial_eta2 = Eta2_partial)
      tidy.df <- tidy.df %>%
        left_join(eta2, by = c("term" = "Parameter"))
      return(tidy.df)
    })) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(term == "s(QSM)") %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, p.value)

save_table(reg_table(qsm_cog_main_results, c("ROI", "Cog.Domain"),
                     c("Region", "Domain"), list(label_roi, label_cog)),
           "table5_qsm_cognition", "Table 5: QSM-cognition associations")
```

```{r cleanup_qsm_cog_models}
rm(qsm_cog_main_models)
gc()
```

### QSM x group interactions

```{r qsm_cognition_interactions, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint", fig.width=12}
qsm_cog_int_models <- df_qsm_cog %>%
  group_by(ROI, Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        Cog.Score ~ s(age, k=6) + s(QSM, k=5) + s(QSM, by = ostudy.group, k=5) +
                    ostudy.group + osex + s(subid, bs = "re"),
        method = "REML", data = cur_data()
      ), error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

qsm_cog_int_results <- qsm_cog_int_models %>%
  mutate(
    tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "ostudy.group")) %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, p.value)

qsm_cog_int_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  present_results()

sig_interactions <- qsm_cog_int_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05)

if (nrow(sig_interactions) > 0) {
  sig_models <- qsm_cog_int_models %>%
    semi_join(sig_interactions, by = c("ROI", "Cog.Domain"))
  
  plots <- sig_models %>%
    slice_head(n = 6) %>%
    mutate(
      plot = pmap(
        list(model, ROI, Cog.Domain),
        function(m, r, c) {
          partial_resid_plot(
            m,
            term = "QSM",
            int.term = "ostudy.group",
            group.term = "subid",
            plot.title = paste(label_roi(r), "-", label_cog(c)),
            xlabel = paste0(label_roi(r), " Susceptibility (ppm)"),
            ylabel = label_cog(c),
            show.data = TRUE
          ) +
            scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, name = "Group") +
            scale_fill_manual(values  = group_colors, name = "Group")
        }
      )
    )

  wrap_plots(plots$plot, ncol = 3)
} else {
  cat("No significant QSM x group interactions at p < 0.05")
}
rm(qsm_cog_int_models, qsm_cog_int_results)
```

### By group

Joint models with a `by`-factor smooth fit per ROI x Domain, with a separate
smooth estimated for each group. Two equivalent parameterisations are compared:

- **Unordered factor** (`by = study.group`): each group gets its own smooth, each tested
  against zero. Effect sizes (partial η²) per group reflect difference from zero (flat slope).
- **Ordered factor** (`by = ostudy.group`): base smooth (TD) + difference smooth (PS - TD)
  tested directly against zero. Should yield the same fit as above, but changes statistical decomposition. 
  We now test if the *difference* between PS and TD is non-zero, akin to a 
  classic interaction model (do the slopes ever differ?).
  Effect size reflects the difference between groups.

```{r qsm_cognition_by_group, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
df_qsm_cog_bygroup <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(rois$primary), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency), names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score") %>%
  mutate(Domain = str_remove(Cog.Domain, "_Efficiency"))

# Fit both parameterisations in a single pass - same data, same random effects
qsm_bygrp_models <- df_qsm_cog_bygroup %>%
  group_by(ROI, Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    mod_unord = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        Cog.Score ~ s(age, k=6) + s(QSM, by = study.group, k=5) +
                    study.group + osex + s(subid, bs = "re"),
        method = "REML", data = cur_data()
      ), error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    mod_ord = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        Cog.Score ~ s(age, k=6) + s(QSM, k=5) + s(QSM, by = ostudy.group, k=5) +
                    ostudy.group + osex + s(subid, bs = "re"),
        method = "REML", data = cur_data()
      ), error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Unordered: per-group smooth significance + eta² ---
qsm_cog_bygroup_results <- qsm_bygrp_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(mod_unord, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(mod_unord, ~ {
    tidy.df <- broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE)
    eta2 <- tryCatch(
      effectsize::eta_squared(.x, partial = TRUE) %>%
        select(Parameter, partial_eta2 = Eta2_partial),
      error = function(e) tibble(Parameter = character(), partial_eta2 = numeric())
    )
    tidy.df %>% left_join(eta2, by = c("term" = "Parameter"))
  })) %>%
  select(ROI, Cog.Domain, tidy) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "s\\(QSM\\)")) %>%
  mutate(
    study.group = str_extract(term, "TD|PS"),
    Domain      = str_remove(Cog.Domain, "_Efficiency")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(study.group)) %>%
  group_by(study.group, Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(study.group, Cog.Domain, p.value)

# --- Ordered: difference smooth (PS - TD) - formal interaction test + eta² ---
qsm_bygrp_diff_results <- qsm_bygrp_models %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(mod_ord, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(mod_ord, ~ {
    tidy.df <- broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE)
    eta2 <- tryCatch(
      effectsize::eta_squared(.x, partial = TRUE) %>%
        select(Parameter, partial_eta2 = Eta2_partial),
      error = function(e) tibble(Parameter = character(), partial_eta2 = numeric())
    )
    tidy.df %>% left_join(eta2, by = c("term" = "Parameter"))
  })) %>%
  select(ROI, Cog.Domain, tidy) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "ostudy\\.groupPS")) %>%
  mutate(Domain = str_remove(Cog.Domain, "_Efficiency")) %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, p.value)

# Per-group smooth results: both TD and PS terms, with eta²
cat("**Unordered model - per-group QSM smooths (each tested against zero):**\n")
qsm_cog_bygroup_results %>%
  select(study.group, ROI, Cog.Domain, edf, statistic, p.value, partial_eta2, p.fdr) %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, ROI, study.group) %>%
  present_results()

# Ordered model: difference smooth (interaction test) with eta²
cat("**Ordered model - PS - TD difference smooth (interaction test):**\n")
qsm_bygrp_diff_results %>%
  select(ROI, Cog.Domain, term, edf, statistic, p.value, partial_eta2, p.fdr) %>%
  present_results()
# Data no longer needed - models fitted; results extracted
rm(df_qsm_cog_bygroup)
```

```{r qsm_cog_composite_eta, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
# Extract results to visualize 
df_comp_cog <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency), names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score") %>%
  mutate(QSM = Subcortex_Total)

extract_qsm_eta <- function(model) {
  broom::tidy(model, parametric = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(effectsize::eta_squared(model, partial = TRUE) %>%
                select(Parameter, partial_eta2 = Eta2_partial),
              by = c("term" = "Parameter"))
}

# Total (whole-group) main effect: s(QSM)
comp_total <- df_comp_cog %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
    mgcv::gam(Cog.Score ~ s(age) + s(QSM) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs = "re"),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, extract_qsm_eta)) %>%
  select(Cog.Domain, tidy) %>% unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(term == "s(QSM)") %>% mutate(study.group = "Total")

# Per-group (TD/PS) smooths via the unordered by-factor specification
comp_bygrp <- df_comp_cog %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
    mgcv::gam(Cog.Score ~ s(age, k = 6) + s(QSM, by = study.group, k = 5) +
                study.group + osex + s(subid, bs = "re"),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, extract_qsm_eta)) %>%
  select(Cog.Domain, tidy) %>% unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "s\\(QSM\\)")) %>%
  mutate(study.group = str_extract(term, "TD|PS")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(study.group))

# Composite is a single pre-specified global measure (not part of the ROI FDR
# family), so significance uses the raw p; p.fdr is set to p.value for the shared
# asterisk logic in Figure 3 (note this in the figure legend).
qsm_cog_composite_results <- bind_rows(comp_total, comp_bygrp) %>%
  transmute(ROI = "Subcortex_Total", Cog.Domain,
            Domain = str_remove(Cog.Domain, "_Efficiency"),
            partial_eta2, p.value, p.fdr = p.value, study.group)

rm(df_comp_cog, comp_total, comp_bygrp)
```

### Age x QSM
This tests whether the QSM-cognition association changes with age, regardless of group. This is a two-way interaction test (age x QSM) using a tensor product smooth.  

```{r qsm_cognition_age_interaction, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint", eval=FALSE}
qsm_cog_ageint_models <- df_qsm_cog %>%
  group_by(ROI, Cog.Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(
        QSM ~ s(age,k=6) + s(Cog.Score,k=4) + ti(age,Cog.Score,k=4) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs="re"),
        method = "REML",
        data = cur_data()
      ), error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

qsm_cog_ageint_results <- qsm_cog_ageint_models %>%
  mutate(
    tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE))
  ) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "ti")) %>%
  group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Cog.Domain, p.value)

qsm_cog_ageint_results %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  present_results()

sig_interactions <- qsm_cog_ageint_results %>%
  filter(p.fdr < 0.05)

if (nrow(sig_interactions) > 0) {
  sig_models <- qsm_cog_ageint_models %>%

  plots <- sig_models %>%
    mutate(
      plot = pmap(
        list(model, ROI, Cog.Domain),
        function(m, r, c) {
          partial_resid_plot(
            m, term = "age", group.term = "subid",
            plot.title = paste(label_roi(r), "-", label_cog(c)),
            xlabel = "Age (years)", ylabel = label_cog(c),
            show.data = TRUE, add.intercept = TRUE
          )
        }
      )

  wrap_plots(plots$plot, ncol = 3)
} else {

}
```

# Mediation Analysis

Does subcortical iron (susceptibility) mediate the association between group and cognition, allowing the indirect effect to be moderated by the observed nonlinear age effects of susceptibility? Due to the nonlinear effects of age, we cannon fit using `mediate`. Instead, we have to fit using a Bayesian spline model.

## Group --> QSM --> Cognition, Moderated by Age

The indirect effect of diagnosis on cognition via QSM may vary nonlinearly with age. We fit a bivariate Bayesian model with by-group spline age trajectories for both paths, then compute the conditional indirect effect as a curve over age. Mediation is conducted on the whole-subcortex composite (Subcortex_Total) only - no ROI gating - and reported for each of the five cognitive domains.

```{r brms_modmed, cache=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# Run this chunk interactively (not during knit) to fit all moderated mediation models.
# Results are saved to Models/med_results_modmed.rds and loaded automatically during knit.
#
# Model: bivariate Bayesian GAM (brms) encoding the product-of-coefficients estimator.
#   a-path: Group -> QSM trajectory difference (age-varying, by-group spline)
#   b-path: QSM -> Cognition (linear, constant across age)
#   indirect(age) = a-path(age) x b-path  [age-moderated indirect effect]
#   `dataset` is NOT included: cohorts share identical protocol/scanner/battery and
#   their age ranges are near-collinear with `s(age, by=study.group)` anyway.
# Note: This code was generated by Claude (Opus 4.8; https://www.anthropic.com/) and checked by the user. 
dir.create("Models", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ----- Data preparation -------------------------------------------------------
# Mediation is conducted on the whole-subcortex composite (Subcortex_Total).

df_med_prep_modmed <- df %>%
  select(subid, age, osex, study.group, Subcortex_Total,
         all_of(cog_measures$efficiency)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cog_measures$efficiency),
               names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score")

# ----- Analysis grid: global composite x all cognitive domains ----------------
analysis_grid_modmed <- expand_grid(
  ROI_Name   = rois$global,                 # Subcortex_Total
  Cog_Domain = cog_measures$efficiency
)
cat(sprintf("Analysis grid: %d Subcortex_Total x cognitive-domain pairs\n",
            nrow(analysis_grid_modmed)))

# ----- Model fitting function ------------------------------------------------
run_spline_modmed <- function(ROI_Name, Cog_Domain, dataset) {
  curr_data <- dataset %>%
    filter(Cog.Domain == Cog_Domain) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(c("Cog.Score", ROI_Name, "age", "osex", "study.group"))) %>%
    rename(QSM = all_of(ROI_Name), Cog = Cog.Score) %>%
    mutate(study.group = factor(study.group, levels = c("TD", "PS")))

  # Reference sex: use the reference level of the ordered factor 
  ref_sex <- levels(curr_data$osex)[1]

  tryCatch({
    brms_fit <- brm(
      # a-path model: group x age-varying iron trajectory
      bf(QSM ~ study.group + s(age, by = study.group) + osex + (1 | subid)) +
      # b-path model: iron -> cognition, controlling for group and age trajectory
      bf(Cog ~ QSM + study.group + s(age, by = study.group) + osex + (1 | subid)) +
      set_rescor(FALSE),   # separate residual variances; correlation absorbed by shared predictors
      data       = curr_data,
      family     = gaussian(),
      backend    = "cmdstanr",
      chains     = 4,
      cores      = 4,
      iter       = n_brms_iter,
      warmup     = n_brms_warmup,
      seed       = 1234,
      control    = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
      file       = sprintf("Models/modmed_%s_%s", ROI_Name, Cog_Domain),
      file_refit = "on_change",
      refresh    = 500
    )

    # b-path: posterior draws for the QSM -> Cog coefficient
    draws     <- as_draws_df(brms_fit)
    b_path_df <- draws %>% select(.draw, b_path = b_Cog_QSM)

    # Prediction grid for the a-path: marginalise over subjects (re_formula = NA),
    # hold sex at reference level
    age_seq   <- seq(floor(min(curr_data$age)), ceiling(max(curr_data$age)), by = .2)
    pred_grid <- expand_grid(
      age         = age_seq,
      study.group = factor(c("TD", "PS"), levels = c("TD", "PS")),
      osex        = ordered(ref_sex, levels = levels(curr_data$osex)),
      subid       = "new_subject"
    )

    # Get posterior predictive means for QSM across age for each group
    m_preds <- pred_grid %>%
      add_epred_draws(brms_fit, resp = "QSM", re_formula = NA, allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(age, study.group, .draw, QSM_pred = .epred)

    # Age-moderated indirect effect: delta-QSM(age) x b-path
    med_curve <- m_preds %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = study.group, values_from = QSM_pred) %>%
      left_join(b_path_df, by = ".draw") %>%
      mutate(
        a_path_local    = PS - TD,              # PS - TD gap in QSM at this age
        indirect_effect = a_path_local * b_path # product-of-coefficients indirect effect
      ) %>%
      group_by(age) %>%
      summarise(
        Mediation_Est = mean(indirect_effect),
        CI_lo         = quantile(indirect_effect, 0.025),
        CI_hi         = quantile(indirect_effect, 0.975),
        Prob_Dir      = max(mean(indirect_effect > 0), mean(indirect_effect < 0)),
        .groups       = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        ROI_Name   = ROI_Name,
        Cog_Domain = Cog_Domain,
        pseudo_p   = 2 * (1 - Prob_Dir)
      )

    rm(brms_fit, draws, m_preds, pred_grid)
    gc()
    return(med_curve)

  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("Error in %s x %s: %s", ROI_Name, Cog_Domain, e$message))
    tibble()
  })
}

# ----- Run -------------------------------------------------------------------
med_results.modmed <- analysis_grid_modmed %>%
  pmap(~ run_spline_modmed(..1, ..2, dataset = df_med_prep_modmed)) %>%
  list_rbind()

saveRDS(med_results.modmed, "Models/med_results_modmed.rds")
```

```{r brms_modmed_load, cache=FALSE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
  # other ROIs from earlier runs; re-running brms_modmed regenerates global-only.)

    filter(ROI_Name == "Subcortex_Total")
} else {
```
