```{r brms_modmed_viz, fig.width=18, fig.height=4}
# Cognitive-domain display order: Overall first, then the rest
dom_levels <- c("Overall_Efficiency",
                setdiff(cog_measures$efficiency, "Overall_Efficiency"))

# Figure: conditional indirect effect for Subcortex Total, one panel per domain
if (exists("med_results.modmed") && nrow(med_results.modmed) > 0) {
  # Age-varying conditional indirect effect, one domain per row (shared x-axis).
  md_modmed <- med_results.modmed %>%
    mutate(Domain = factor(label_cog(Cog_Domain), levels = label_cog(dom_levels)),
           sig = CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0)

  # Onset: earliest age at which the indirect effect becomes credible, per domain
  onset_modmed <- md_modmed %>%
    group_by(Domain) %>%
    summarise(onset = if (any(sig)) min(age[sig]) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!is.na(onset))

  p_modmed <- ggplot(md_modmed, aes(x = age, y = Mediation_Est)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    # full curve in grey (not credible)
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_lo, ymax = CI_hi), fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.8) +
    # credible portion in colour (95% CI excludes 0)
    geom_ribbon(data = dplyr::filter(md_modmed, sig),
                aes(ymin = CI_lo, ymax = CI_hi), fill = "#d73027", alpha = 0.30) +
    geom_line(data = dplyr::filter(md_modmed, sig), color = "#d73027", linewidth = 1.1) +
    # onset marker + age label
    geom_vline(data = onset_modmed, aes(xintercept = onset),
               linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = onset_modmed,
              aes(x = onset, y = Inf, label = paste0(round(onset, 1), " yr")),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ Domain, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "right") +
    labs(
      title = "Age-dependent mediation effect",
      x = "Age (years)", y = "Indirect effect (ppm x performance units)"
    ) +
    theme(strip.background   = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 0),
          panel.spacing.y    = unit(3, "pt"))

  p_modmed
  save_fig(p_modmed, "fig_modmed_global", width = 6, height = 9)
} else {
  cat("Moderated mediation results not available.\n")
}

modmed_stats_table <- med_results.modmed %>%
  group_by(Cog_Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    # Cap at age 28 so the peak isn't driven by the sparse upper tail.
    # which.max(abs(...)) finds the index of the largest effect up to age 28
    Ref_Idx = which.max(abs(Mediation_Est[age <= 28])),

    Age_of_Peak        = age[Ref_Idx],
    Peak_Mediation_Est = Mediation_Est[Ref_Idx],
    Peak_CI_lo         = CI_lo[Ref_Idx],
    Peak_CI_hi         = CI_hi[Ref_Idx],

    # Onset: first age at which the credible interval excludes zero
    Age_of_Onset = if (any(CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0)) age[min(which(CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0))] else NA,

    # Probability of direction across the whole age range
    Max_Prob_Dir = max(Prob_Dir),
    pseudo_p     = 2 * (1 - Max_Prob_Dir),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

modmed_final_report <- modmed_stats_table %>%
  mutate(
    Evidence = case_when(
      Max_Prob_Dir >= 0.99  ~ "Strong",
      Max_Prob_Dir >= 0.975 ~ "Moderate",
      Max_Prob_Dir >= 0.95  ~ "Suggestive",
      TRUE                  ~ "Weak"
    ),
    Peak_95_CI = sprintf("[%0.3f, %0.3f]", Peak_CI_lo, Peak_CI_hi),
    # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the five domains
    fdr_p   = p.adjust(pseudo_p, method = "fdr"),
    FDR_Sig = if_else(fdr_p < 0.05, "*", ""),
    Domain  = factor(label_cog(Cog_Domain), levels = label_cog(dom_levels))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Domain) %>%
  select(Domain, Age_of_Onset, Peak_Mediation_Est, Peak_95_CI,
         Max_Prob_Dir, Evidence, FDR_Sig, fdr_p)

save_table(modmed_final_report, "table6_modmed_global",
           "Moderated mediation: Subcortex Total -> cognition by domain")

modmed_final_report %>%
  mutate(
    Peak_Mediation_Est = round(Peak_Mediation_Est, 3),
    Max_Prob_Dir       = round(Max_Prob_Dir, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(-fdr_p) %>%
  kbl(
    caption   = "Moderated mediation: Subcortex Total -> cognition, by domain",
    col.names = c("Cognitive Domain", "Age of Onset", "Peak Indirect Effect",
                  "95% Credible Interval", "Max P(Direction)", "Evidence", "FDR"),
    align     = c("l","c","r","c","r","l","c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(which(modmed_final_report$FDR_Sig == "*"), bold = TRUE, color = "darkred")
```

# Figure 4: Mediation

```{r figure_4_mediation, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
# Figure 4 (mediation): A path model, B age-dependent conditional indirect effect

# --- Panel C: Conceptual path diagram (Inkscape template) ---
# Representative pathway: Subcortex Total -> Overall Cognition
# Uses real coefficients from the brms moderated mediation model

# --- Panel A path values (computed from the fitted results so the labels never go stale) ---
.mm_ov  <- med_results.modmed %>% filter(Cog_Domain == "Overall_Efficiency")
.mm_sig <- .mm_ov %>% filter(CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0)
.onset  <- if (nrow(.mm_sig)) min(.mm_sig$age) else NA_real_
.peak   <- .mm_ov %>% filter(age <= 28) %>% slice(which.max(abs(Mediation_Est)))
.pdir   <- max(.mm_ov$Prob_Dir, na.rm = TRUE)

.fit_path <- "Models/modmed_Subcortex_Total_Overall_Efficiency.rds"
if (file.exists(.fit_path)) {
  .fe <- brms::fixef(readRDS(.fit_path),
                     probs = c(0.0005, 0.005, 0.025, 0.975, 0.995, 0.9995))
  # Significance from the posterior: a-path (constant group->iron) is n.s.; the effect
  # is carried by the age moderation, reflected in the credible indirect-effect box.
  .star <- function(r) {
    e <- .fe[r, ]
    if (e[["Q0.05"]] > 0 || e[["Q99.95"]] < 0) "***"
    else if (e[["Q0.5"]] > 0 || e[["Q99.5"]] < 0) "**"
    else if (e[["Q2.5"]] > 0 || e[["Q97.5"]] < 0) "*"
    else " (n.s.)"
  }
  a_lab <- sprintf("Path a: β = %.3f%s\nGroup -> Iron (age-moderated)",
                   .fe["QSM_study.groupPS", "Estimate"], .star("QSM_study.groupPS"))
  b_lab <- sprintf("Path b: β = %.2f%s\nIron -> Cognition",
                   .fe["Cog_QSM", "Estimate"], .star("Cog_QSM"))
  d_lab <- sprintf("Direct: β = %.3f%s\n(c' path)",
                   .fe["Cog_study.groupPS", "Estimate"], .star("Cog_study.groupPS"))
} else {
  a_lab <- "Path a\nGroup -> Iron"; b_lab <- "Path b\nIron -> Cognition"; d_lab <- "Direct (c' path)"
}
ind_lab <- sprintf("Indirect effect = a x b x f(Age)\nPeak: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]\nOnset age: %.1f yr | P(dir) = %.3f",
                   .peak$Mediation_Est, .peak$CI_lo, .peak$CI_hi, .onset, .pdir)

# Box positions (x, y centers) and sizes
boxes <- tibble(
  label = c("DIAGNOSTIC\nGROUP\n(TD = 0, PS = 1)",
            "SUBCORTICAL IRON\nACCUMULATION\n(Global subcortical QSM)",
            "OVERALL COGNITIVE\nPERFORMANCE"),
  x     = c(0, 5, 10),
  y     = c(0, 4, 0),
  w     = c(3.2, 3.8, 3.2),
  h     = c(1.8, 1.8, 1.5)
)

# Moderator node
mod_node <- tibble(label = "AGE\n(8-31 years)", x = 2.5, y = 7, r = 1.2)

# Arrow definitions
arrows <- tibble(
  x    = c(1.6,  6.9,  1.6),
  y    = c(0.0,  4.0,  0.0),
  xend = c(3.1,  8.4,  8.4),
  yend = c(4.0,  0.75, 0.0),
  lty  = c("solid", "solid", "solid"),
  col  = c("grey30", "grey30", "grey50")
)

# Arrow labels (a/b/direct pulled dynamically above)
arrow_labels <- tibble(
  label = c(a_lab, b_lab, d_lab),
  x     = c(1.6, 8.5, 5.0),
  y     = c(2.4, 2.8, -0.9),
  hjust = c(0, 1, 0.5),
  size  = c(3, 3, 3)
)

# Indirect effect annotation (pulled dynamically above)
indirect_label <- tibble(
  label = ind_lab,
  x = 5, y = -2.2
)

p4_C <- ggplot() +
  # Boxes
  geom_rect(data = boxes,
            aes(xmin = x - w/2, xmax = x + w/2, ymin = y - h/2, ymax = y + h/2),
            fill = "white", color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = boxes, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 3, lineheight = 0.9, fontface = "bold") +
  # Moderator ellipse (approximate with a wider rect with rounded corners)
  annotate("rect", xmin = mod_node$x - 1.5, xmax = mod_node$x + 1.5,
           ymin = mod_node$y - 0.8, ymax = mod_node$y + 0.8,
           fill = "#f0f0f0", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = mod_node$x, y = mod_node$y, label = mod_node$label,
           size = 3, fontface = "bold.italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  # Moderation arrow (dashed, from Age node to Path a midpoint)
  annotate("segment", x = 2.5, y = 6.2, xend = 2.2, yend = 2.8,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed"),
           linetype = "dashed", color = "#b35806", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.4, y = 4.8, label = "Moderates\nPath a",
           size = 2.8, color = "#b35806", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  # Path arrows
  geom_segment(data = arrows,
               aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, linetype = lty, color = col),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_linetype_identity() +
  # Path labels
  geom_text(data = arrow_labels,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
            size = arrow_labels$size, lineheight = 0.85, color = "grey20") +
  # Indirect effect summary box
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2.5, xmax = 7.5, ymin = -3.1, ymax = -1.3,
           fill = "#fffbe6", color = "#b35806", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(data = indirect_label, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            size = 2.8, lineheight = 1, color = "#b35806") +
  # Styling
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 12), ylim = c(-3.5, 8.5), clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Representative mechanistic pathway: Global subcortical -> Overall Cognition") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

# --- Assemble Figure 4 ---
if (exists("med_results.modmed") && nrow(med_results.modmed) > 0) {
  fig4 <- (p4_C | p_modmed) +
    plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1)) +

  print(fig4)

} else {
```

# Region-wise Mediation (SN & Pallidum)

Region-wise moderated mediation for the two FDR-significant divergence regions (substantia nigra and
pallidum), paralleling the whole-subcortex analysis (Table 4 / Figure 4) and requested in review.
Fits reuse the identical model/priors as the global analysis and the cached brms models in `Models/`
(`file_refit = "on_change"`), so re-knitting does not refit.

```{r modmed_region_sn_pallidum, cache=FALSE, dependson="brms_modmed"}
region_rois_mm <- c("SN_Total", "Pallidum_Total")
reg_lab_mm     <- c(SN_Total = "Substantia Nigra", Pallidum_Total = "Pallidum")

df_med_prep_region <- df %>%
  select(subid, age, osex, study.group, all_of(region_rois_mm),
         all_of(cog_measures$efficiency)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency),
               names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score")

med_results.modmed_region <- expand_grid(ROI_Name   = region_rois_mm,
                                          Cog_Domain = cog_measures$efficiency) %>%
  pmap(~ run_spline_modmed(..1, ..2, dataset = df_med_prep_region)) %>%
  list_rbind()

# Summary: peak indirect effect, onset, pd, and FDR within region across the 5 domains
modmed_region_summary <- med_results.modmed_region %>%
  arrange(ROI_Name, Cog_Domain, age) %>%
  group_by(ROI_Name, Cog_Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    Ref          = which.max(abs(Mediation_Est[age <= 28])),
    Age_of_Peak  = age[age <= 28][Ref],
    Peak_Est     = Mediation_Est[age <= 28][Ref],
    Peak_CI_lo   = CI_lo[age <= 28][Ref],
    Peak_CI_hi   = CI_hi[age <= 28][Ref],
    Age_of_Onset = if (any(CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0)) age[min(which(CI_lo > 0 | CI_hi < 0))] else NA_real_,
    pd           = max(Prob_Dir),
    pseudo_p     = 2 * (1 - max(Prob_Dir)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ROI_Name) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(pseudo_p, "fdr")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    Region       = unname(reg_lab_mm[ROI_Name]),
    Domain       = factor(label_cog(Cog_Domain), levels = label_cog(cog_table_order)),
    Age_of_Onset = round(Age_of_Onset, 1),
    Peak_Est     = round(Peak_Est, 3),
    CI_lo        = round(Peak_CI_lo, 3), CI_hi = round(Peak_CI_hi, 3),
    pd           = round(pd, 3), FDR = round(FDR, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Region, levels = unname(reg_lab_mm)), Domain)

save_table(modmed_region_summary, "supptable_modmed_sn_pallidum",
           "Region-wise moderated mediation (SN, pallidum): peak indirect effect, onset, pd, FDR")

  mutate(Domain = factor(label_cog(Cog_Domain), levels = label_cog(cog_table_order)),

onset_region <- md_region %>% group_by(Region, Domain) %>%
  summarise(onset = if (any(sig)) min(age[sig]) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") %>%
```

### Age-Overlap Validation

EF (youth) and MOTIVE (young adults) share a narrow age range. Here we (1) visualise the
trajectories of both datasets across the full age span, and (2) formally test whether there is a
residual dataset main effect or a dataset x group interaction **within the overlapping age window
only**. Non-significant results there confirm that the two datasets can be pooled.

```{r sensitivity_overlap_viz, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Identify overlap zone dynamically from data
age_bounds <- df %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(lo = min(age, na.rm = TRUE), hi = max(age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

overlap_lo <- max(age_bounds$lo)
overlap_hi <- min(age_bounds$hi)

cat(sprintf("Overlap zone: %.1f - %.1f years\n", overlap_lo, overlap_hi))
cat(sprintf("Sessions in overlap: %d of %d total\n",
            sum(df$age >= overlap_lo & df$age <= overlap_hi, na.rm = TRUE), nrow(df)))
df %>%
  mutate(in_overlap = age >= overlap_lo & age <= overlap_hi) %>%
  count(dataset, study.group, in_overlap) %>%
  filter(in_overlap) %>%
  select(-in_overlap) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sessions per group in overlap zone") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# Full-span trajectories by dataset, with overlap zone shaded
df_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = QSM, color = dataset)) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = overlap_lo, xmax = overlap_hi,
           ymin = -Inf,       ymax = Inf,
           fill = "gold", alpha = 0.20) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.10, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 5),
              se = TRUE, linewidth = 1.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ ROI, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4, labeller = as_labeller(roi_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("EF" = "#1b7837", "MOTIVE" = "#762a83")) +
  labs(
    title    = "QSM Age Trajectories by Dataset",
    subtitle = sprintf("Gold band = age overlap zone (%.0f-%.0f y)", overlap_lo, overlap_hi),
    x = "Age (years)", y = "Susceptibility (ppm)", color = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r sensitivity_overlap_test}
# In the narrow overlap window, age range is too small for a smooth - use linear age.
# Model: QSM ~ group * dataset + sex + age (linear)
# Key terms: datasetMOTIVE (main effect) and study.groupPS:datasetMOTIVE (interaction)
df_overlap_long <- df %>%
  filter(age >= overlap_lo, age <= overlap_hi) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(rois$primary), names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM")

overlap_models <- df_overlap_long %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    model = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(QSM ~ study.group * dataset + osex + age + s(subid, bs="re"),
                method = "REML",
                data = cur_data()),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null))

overlap_results <- overlap_models %>%
  mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE))) %>%
  select(-model) %>%
  unnest(tidy) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "dataset")) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(term, p.value)

overlap_results %>%
  present_results()
```

# Medication Sensitivity {.tabset}

Sensitivity analyses assessing whether psychotropic medication confounds or
masks the primary findings. **Medications** are harmonized across EF + MOTIVE (curated EF
data; shared psychotropic class flags), and - because they are endorsed almost exclusively by
PS in both cohorts - are analyzed *within PS* on the combined sample (adjusting for cohort).
All models are GAMMs of susceptibility on a smooth of age with a
subject random intercept, mirroring the primary analyses. FDR is applied across ROIs within
each predictor; effect sizes and CIs matter more than thresholds.

```{r ms_sensitivity_prep, cache=TRUE, dependson="df_checkpoint"}
# Combined-cohort long frame with harmonized subject-level medications (joined on bblid)
df_med_ms <- df %>%
  left_join(med_harmonized %>% select(-dataset), by = "bblid") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(c(rois$primary, rois$global)),
               names_to = "ROI", values_to = "QSM") %>%
  filter(!is.na(QSM)) %>%
  mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = c(rois$primary, rois$global)))

# Adjusted mean effect of a binary 0/1 predictor on QSM, per ROI. `covars` is the
# (non-age) adjustment set, e.g. "osex + dataset" (combined meds) or "osex + study.group".
qsm_pred_means <- function(data, predictor, covars = "osex") {
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf("QSM ~ s(age, k=6) + %s + %s + s(subid, bs='re')",
                            covars, predictor))
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor]])) %>%
    group_by(ROI) %>%
    summarise(
      n_yes = sum(.data[[predictor]] == 1),
      n_obs = n(),
      model = list(tryCatch(mgcv::gam(fml, method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
                            error = function(e) NULL)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
    mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE) %>%
                        filter(term == predictor))) %>%
    select(ROI, n_yes, n_obs, tidy) %>%
    unnest(tidy) %>%
    mutate(Predictor = predictor,
           p.fdr     = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr"),
           ROI       = label_roi(as.character(ROI))) %>%
    select(Predictor, ROI, n_yes, n_obs, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p.fdr) %>%
    arrange(p.value)
}

# Age x predictor moderation (ordered-factor difference smooth) for one ROI.
qsm_pred_agemod <- function(data, predictor, roi = "Subcortex_Total", covars = "osex") {
  d <- data %>%
    filter(ROI == roi, !is.na(.data[[predictor]])) %>%
    mutate(predf = ordered(.data[[predictor]], levels = c(0, 1)))
  fml <- as.formula(sprintf(
    "QSM ~ s(age, k=6) + s(age, by=predf, k=4) + %s + predf + s(subid, bs='re')", covars))
  m <- tryCatch(mgcv::gam(fml, method = "REML", data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
  broom::tidy(m, parametric = FALSE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "s\\(age\\):predf")) %>%
    transmute(Predictor = predictor, ROI = label_roi(roi),
              edf, statistic, p.value)
}
```

## Medication Effects in PS (EF + MOTIVE)

Do antidepressant/stimulant/any-psychotropic exposures relate to subcortical iron in PS, as
a mean shift or by moderating the age trajectory? Estimated on the combined EF + MOTIVE PS
sample (adjusting for age, sex, and cohort), which gives the largest available endorsement
counts (stimulant ~ 30, antidepressant ~ 31, any-psychotropic ~ 54).

```{r ms_meds_ps, cache=TRUE, dependson="ms_sensitivity_prep"}
df_ps_ms  <- filter(df_med_ms, study.group == "PS")
med_preds <- c("med_any_psych", "med_antidepressant", "med_stimulant")
med_lab   <- c(med_any_psych = "Any psychotropic",
               med_antidepressant = "Antidepressant", med_stimulant = "Stimulant")

med_mean_results <- map_dfr(med_preds, ~ qsm_pred_means(df_ps_ms, .x, covars = "osex + dataset")) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = med_lab[Predictor])
save_table(med_mean_results, "supptable_meds_ps_meaneffect",
           "Medication mean effect on QSM within PS, EF+MOTIVE (age/sex/cohort-adjusted)")
cat("**Mean medication effect on QSM within PS (EF + MOTIVE; age/sex/cohort-adjusted):**\n")
med_mean_results %>% present_results()

# Age moderation by medication, whole-subcortex composite
med_agemod <- map_dfr(med_preds, ~ qsm_pred_agemod(df_ps_ms, .x, covars = "osex + dataset")) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = med_lab[Predictor], p.fdr = p.adjust(p.value, "fdr"))
cat("\n**Age x medication moderation (Subcortex Total, PS, EF + MOTIVE):**\n")
med_agemod %>% present_results()
```

## Effect on the PS-TD Group Difference

Does adjusting for medications change the PS-TD susceptibility difference?
Because meds are PS-only, adjusting for a medication contrasts *unmedicated PS vs TD* - if
the gap grows, medication was masking it. Medication adjustment uses the full combined
EF + MOTIVE sample.

```{r ms_groupdiff_sensitivity, cache=TRUE, dependson="ms_sensitivity_prep"}
# PS-TD coefficient per ROI under a base model and with one extra covariate added.
groupPS_under <- function(data, cov = NULL, label) {
  d   <- data
  rhs <- "s(age, k=6) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs='re')"
  if (!is.null(cov)) {
    d   <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[cov]]))
    rhs <- sprintf("s(age, k=6) + osex + study.group + %s + s(subid, bs='re')", cov)
  }
  d %>% group_by(ROI) %>%
    summarise(model = list(tryCatch(mgcv::gam(as.formula(paste("QSM ~", rhs)),
              method = "REML", data = cur_data()), error = function(e) NULL)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
    mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = TRUE) %>%
                        filter(term == "study.groupPS"))) %>%
    select(ROI, tidy) %>% unnest(tidy) %>%
    transmute(ROI = label_roi(as.character(ROI)), Scenario = label,
              PS_TD_est = estimate, se = std.error, p.value)
}

show_groupdiff <- function(tbl, cap) {
  tbl %>%
    mutate(PS_TD_est = round(PS_TD_est, 4)) %>%
    select(ROI, Scenario, PS_TD_est) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = PS_TD_est) %>%
    kbl(caption = cap) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
    scroll_box(width = "100%")
}

# (A) Medication adjustment - combined EF + MOTIVE sample
groupdiff_meds <- bind_rows(
  groupPS_under(df_med_ms, NULL,                 "Base (age + sex)"),
  groupPS_under(df_med_ms, "med_antidepressant", "+ Antidepressant"),
  groupPS_under(df_med_ms, "med_stimulant",      "+ Stimulant"),
  groupPS_under(df_med_ms, "med_any_psych",      "+ Any psychotropic")
) %>%
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c(
    "Base (age + sex)", "+ Antidepressant", "+ Stimulant", "+ Any psychotropic")))

save_table(groupdiff_meds, "supptable_groupdiff_med_sensitivity",
           "PS-TD QSM difference under medication adjustment (EF+MOTIVE)")

cat("**Medication adjustment (combined EF + MOTIVE):**\n")
show_groupdiff(groupdiff_meds, "PS-TD susceptibility difference by medication adjustment (EF + MOTIVE)")
```

## Iron Supplements

Oral iron supplementation directly affects the outcome, making it the most important
potential confound for a brain-iron study. It is captured from EF (curated records) and from
MOTIVE (parsed from the free-text `dwmedlist`, where the binary class flags miss it). It is
rare, so rather than model it we report prevalence and confirm that excluding iron-supplement
users does not move the headline group difference.

```{r ms_iron_supplement, cache=TRUE, dependson="ms_sensitivity_prep"}
iron_ids <- med_harmonized %>% filter(iron_supplement == 1) %>% pull(bblid) %>% as.character()

# Iron-supplement users present in the analysis sample (TD/PS), by cohort and group
iron_users <- df %>%
  distinct(subid, bblid, dataset, study.group) %>%
  filter(as.character(bblid) %in% iron_ids)
cat(sprintf("Iron-supplement users in the analysis sample: %d subjects\n",
            n_distinct(iron_users$subid)))
iron_users %>% count(dataset, study.group, name = "n") %>% present_results()

# Robustness: whole-subcortex PS-TD difference, all subjects vs excluding iron users
iron_robust <- map_dfr(c("All subjects", "Excluding iron-supplement users"), function(scn) {
  d <- df_med_ms %>% filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total")
  if (scn != "All subjects") d <- d %>% filter(!(as.character(bblid) %in% iron_ids))
  m <- mgcv::gam(QSM ~ s(age, k=6) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs='re'),
                 method = "REML", data = d)
  broom::tidy(m, parametric = TRUE) %>% filter(term == "study.groupPS") %>%
    transmute(Sample = scn, PS_TD_est = estimate, se = std.error, p.value)
})
cat("\n**PS-TD difference (Subcortex Total), with vs without iron-supplement users:**\n")
iron_robust %>% present_results()
```

## Medication-Adjusted Primary Effects

Psychotropic medication was largely a PS-only exposure and could in principle account for the
group effects. As a direct sensitivity check we refit the two headline analyses - the age x group
divergence in subcortical iron and the whole-subcortex iron-cognition association - adding any
psychotropic exposure as a covariate. Participants without a medication record are treated as
unexposed, so the covariate contrasts medicated participants against everyone else, asking whether
the primary effects survive adjustment for it.

```{r ms_medadj_primary, cache=TRUE, dependson="ms_sensitivity_prep"}
# Treat a missing medication record as "no psychotropic" so that TD participants
# (largely unmedicated, sometimes without a med pull) are retained in the contrast.
df_medadj <- df_med_ms %>% mutate(anypsych01 = tidyr::replace_na(med_any_psych, 0L))

## (A) Age x group divergence (difference smooth), unadjusted vs + any psychotropic ----
fit_div <- function(data, add_med) {
  rhs <- "s(age, k=6) + s(age, by=ostudy.group, k=4) + osex + ostudy.group + s(subid, bs='re')"
  if (add_med) rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ anypsych01")
  data %>% group_by(ROI) %>%
    summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(as.formula(paste("QSM ~", rhs)), method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
      error = function(e) NULL)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
    mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE) %>%
                        filter(term == "s(age):ostudy.groupPS"))) %>%
    select(ROI, tidy) %>% unnest(tidy) %>%
    transmute(ROI = label_roi(as.character(ROI)), edf, statistic, p.value)
}

div_medadj_cmp <- left_join(
  fit_div(df_medadj, FALSE) %>% rename(F = statistic, p = p.value),
  fit_div(df_medadj, TRUE)  %>% rename(edf_adj = edf, F_adj = statistic, p_adj = p.value),
  by = "ROI") %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p_adj, "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)
save_table(div_medadj_cmp, "supptable_medadj_agegroup",
           "Age x group divergence in QSM: unadjusted vs medication-adjusted, any psychotropic (difference smooth)")
cat("**Age x group divergence `s(age):groupPS`: unadjusted vs + any psychotropic (FDR on adjusted p)**\n")
div_medadj_cmp %>% present_results()

## (B) Whole-subcortex iron -> cognition, unadjusted vs + any psychotropic ------------
df_cog_medadj <- df_medadj %>%
  filter(ROI == "Subcortex_Total") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(cog_measures$efficiency),
               names_to = "Cog.Domain", values_to = "Cog.Score") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cog.Score))

fit_cog <- function(data, add_med) {
  rhs <- "s(age) + s(QSM) + osex + study.group + s(subid, bs='re')"
  if (add_med) rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ anypsych01")
  data %>% group_by(Cog.Domain) %>%
    summarise(model = list(tryCatch(
      mgcv::gam(as.formula(paste("Cog.Score ~", rhs)), method = "REML", data = cur_data()),
      error = function(e) NULL)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
    mutate(tidy = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x, parametric = FALSE) %>%
                        filter(term == "s(QSM)"))) %>%
    select(Cog.Domain, tidy) %>% unnest(tidy) %>%
    transmute(Domain = label_cog(Cog.Domain), edf, statistic, p.value)
}

cog_medadj_cmp <- left_join(
  fit_cog(df_cog_medadj, FALSE) %>% rename(F = statistic, p = p.value),
  fit_cog(df_cog_medadj, TRUE)  %>% rename(edf_adj = edf, F_adj = statistic, p_adj = p.value),
  by = "Domain") %>%
  mutate(p.fdr = p.adjust(p_adj, "fdr"))
save_table(cog_medadj_cmp, "supptable_medadj_qsm_cog",
           "Whole-subcortex iron-cognition association: unadjusted vs medication-adjusted (any psychotropic)")
cat("\n**Whole-subcortex iron -> cognition `s(QSM)` (Subcortex Total): unadjusted vs + any psychotropic**\n")
cog_medadj_cmp %>% present_results()
```

The age-resolved PS - TD divergence curves (with simultaneous 95% CIs) make the
robustness visual: for the whole-subcortex composite and the two ROIs with the
strongest divergence (substantia nigra, pallidum), the unadjusted and
medication-adjusted curves are nearly superimposed.

```{r ms_medadj_divergence_fig, cache=TRUE, dependson="ms_sensitivity_prep", fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
df_medadj  <- df_med_ms %>% mutate(anypsych01 = tidyr::replace_na(med_any_psych, 0L))
fig_rois <- c("Subcortex_Total", "SN_Total", "Pallidum_Total")

# Reconstruct the age-resolved PS - TD difference curve with a simultaneous 95% CI.
# anypsych01 is a shared, non-age-varying term, so it cancels in the PS-minus-TD lpmatrix
# difference; medication adjustment changes only the coefficients/vcov (i.e. the curve).
divergence_curve <- function(data, roi, add_med, n_pts = 200, n_sim = 10000) {
  d   <- data %>% filter(ROI == roi)
  rhs <- "s(age, k=6) + s(age, by=ostudy.group, k=4) + osex + ostudy.group + s(subid, bs='re')"
  if (add_med) rhs <- paste(rhs, "+ anypsych01")
  mod <- mgcv::gam(as.formula(paste("QSM ~", rhs)), method = "REML", data = d)

  age_range <- quantile(mod$model$age, c(0.01, 0.99))
  age_seq   <- seq(age_range[1], age_range[2], length.out = n_pts)
  glv       <- levels(mod$model$ostudy.group)
  base      <- data.frame(age = age_seq, osex = mod$model$osex[1], subid = mod$model$subid[1])
  if (add_med) base$anypsych01 <- 0L
  nd_PS <- cbind(base, ostudy.group = ordered("PS", levels = glv))
  nd_TD <- cbind(base, ostudy.group = ordered("TD", levels = glv))

  Xp_diff <- predict(mod, nd_PS, type = "lpmatrix") - predict(mod, nd_TD, type = "lpmatrix")
  beta <- coef(mod); Vp <- vcov(mod, unconditional = TRUE)
  est  <- as.numeric(Xp_diff %*% beta)
  se   <- sqrt(rowSums((Xp_diff %*% Vp) * Xp_diff))
  sim0 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_sim, mu = rep(0, length(beta)), Sigma = Vp)
  crit <- quantile(apply(abs(sweep(Xp_diff %*% t(sim0), 1, se, "/")), 2, max), 0.95)

  tibble(ROI = label_roi(roi), age = age_seq, est = est,
         lower = est - crit * se, upper = est + crit * se,
         Model = if (add_med) "Medication-adjusted" else "Unadjusted")
}

div_curves <- map_dfr(fig_rois, function(r)
  bind_rows(divergence_curve(df_medadj, r, FALSE),
            divergence_curve(df_medadj, r, TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(ROI   = factor(ROI, levels = label_roi(fig_rois)),
         Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Unadjusted", "Medication-adjusted")))

p_medadj_div <- ggplot(div_curves, aes(age, est, color = Model, fill = Model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.16, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ ROI, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Unadjusted" = "black", "Medication-adjusted" = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Unadjusted" = "black", "Medication-adjusted" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "PS - TD divergence in subcortical iron, with and without medication adjustment",
       subtitle = "GAMM difference smooth (PS - TD) +/- simultaneous 95% CI; overlapping curves indicate robustness to psychotropic exposure",
       x = "Age (years)", y = "PS - TD susceptibility (ppm)", color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank())
p_medadj_div
save_fig(p_medadj_div, "suppfig_medadj_divergence", width = 11, height = 4)
```

## Visualizations

Visual summaries of the medication associations.

```{r ms_med_forest, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
# Medication associations with iron, within PS: GAMM beta +/- 95% CI per ROI
roi_lvls <- rev(label_roi(c(rois$primary, rois$global)))
p_med_forest <- med_mean_results %>%
  filter(Predictor %in% c("Stimulant", "Antidepressant", "Any psychotropic")) %>%
  mutate(ROI       = factor(ROI, levels = roi_lvls),
         Predictor = factor(Predictor,
                            levels = c("Stimulant", "Antidepressant", "Any psychotropic"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = ROI)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                      xmax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
                  color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor) +
  labs(title = "Medication associations with subcortical iron (within PS, EF + MOTIVE)",
       subtitle = "GAMM β +/- 95% CI, adjusted for age, sex, and cohort; positive = higher susceptibility (more iron)",
       x = "delta Susceptibility (ppm): medicated - unmedicated", y = NULL) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
p_med_forest
save_fig(p_med_forest, "suppfig_meds_ps_forest", width = 11, height = 5)
```
